text.description_html:
Bommer CL3029-6, 6" Double Acting Spring Hinge with Ball Tips

6" Double Acting Spring Hinge with Classic Ball Tips. Mortise Type - Door flange is mortised into edge of door. Jamb flange is surface applied to door jamb. For doors 1-1/4" to 1-3/4" thick.

Bommer 6" Double Acting Spring Hinges permit doors to open in either direction and automatically return to the closed position. Packaged complete with a Pair (2) Double Action Spring Door Hinges, Tension Adjusting Tool, Locking Pins plus wood mounting screws.

The included Tension Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pins hold the Spring in tension after it is set. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes).

Also available without Ball Tips: Bommer 3029-6.

To find the proper size Bommer Double Acting Spring Hinge for your doors weight and width. use the charts here: Bommer Spring Hinge Charts

Specifications of the Bommer CL3029-6 Double Acting Spring Hinge:

  • Material: Steel
  • Hinge Size: 6"
  • Non-Handed
  • Classic Ball Tips
  • Hinge Type: Mortise
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4" - 1-3/4" Thick Doors
  • Maximum Swing: 90º each direction
  • Bommer CL3029-6 Dimension Diagram (PDF)
  • Bommer 3029 Series Installation (PDF)
